timeline_reviews.summary: Transport-only serial Claude CLI stream; manifest accounts for 6,128 source events with no projected semantic events.
Serial parent trajectory: performs direct reference probing without delegation or implementation writes and remains in experiments near timeout.

parallel.requirements: Reimplement gron from observed behavior and bundled docs only, including exact CLI flags, JSON/gron/ungron modes, color, ordering, errors, URL/proxy behavior, and byte-level outputs.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent created trackers for exhaustive probing, Go implementation, and differential testing, then launched a large workflow to probe behavior while the parent continued local probing.
parallel.implementation: Parent began implementation late by writing a Go module, compile script, identifier/string/statement/color/TTY helpers, and gron.go, but did not complete or verify the full command implementation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Final artifact packaging included the new Go files and compile.sh, but there is no observed successful build or integrated acceptance closure before timeout.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted mostly of reference-binary probes and a late check of generated spec files; no completed local compile/test or evaluator-aligned verification closed the loop.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The background workflow was killed with no aggregate result, only two spec files were present at the final check, final response was empty, and official evaluation failed compile with 233 tests not run.

serial.requirements: Serial recognized the same clean-room task and investigated gron behavior through direct execution of the reference binary and bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Serial had no workflows, tasks, or subagents available; a single parent performed all probing, analysis, and intended implementation work.
serial.implementation: Serial did not write implementation source files or a compile script; it remained in behavioral investigation through the end of the trajectory.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Packaged serial artifact contained the original repository/doc artifacts and reference executable but no new reimplementation, and artifact_ok was false.
serial.verification: Serial generated many direct probe observations but no completed candidate implementation to compile or compare against the reference.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out while still probing value lexing, final response was empty, artifact validation failed, and official evaluation failed compile with 233 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Recognized the clean-room requirement to reproduce gron behavior by observing the provided executable and docs only.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Recognized the same reverse-engineering benchmark requirements and probed the executable directly.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-detection difference; both were tackling broad byte-level CLI compatibility and both avoided external-source shortcuts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Created task trackers for exhaustive probing, Go implementation, and differential testing, then delegated exhaustive probing to a workflow.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Had workflows and delegation disabled by configuration and proceeded as a single actor with only Bash-based probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split ownership across parent plus workflow children; serial had no child ownership boundary and no delegation overhead.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow script gave each probe child detailed behavior dimensions and hard benchmark rules, with findings expected as spec files under /tmp/probe/spec.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run kept all observations in one parent context and did not need cross-agent briefs or handoff contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an explicit child-artifact interface, but the problem was not missing context; the interface simply did not yield enough completed artifacts before closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After substantial probing, parallel began a Go reimplementation and wrote go.mod, compile.sh, ident.go, quote.go, statement.go, color.go, tty files, and gron.go.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial never wrote implementation source files; its packaged artifact contained only the starting repository/doc files and executable reference.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel reached a partial source tree while serial stayed in exploration, but the parallel implementation still was not build/acceptance complete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The background workflow launched successfully, spawned many child starts, then ended killed with null result; parent only inspected /tmp/probe/spec near the end.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve; it used immediate Bash outputs from its own probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel carried an unfinished workflow result lifecycle; serial had no comparable child join or result return boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent wrote final workspace source files itself; children worked in scratch/spec paths and no concrete file collision or overwrite was observed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not modify the final implementation workspace with new source, so no merge or shared-state conflict occurred.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had final-workspace writes but not concurrent write collisions; serial had essentially no integration surface beyond the original artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran many behavioral probes and checked workflow spec artifacts but did not close an integrated compile/test loop before official evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran behavioral probes late into the run and likewise did not compile or submit a working reimplementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked final acceptance evidence; parallel had more generated artifacts, but neither got to successful compile before evaluator execution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after the 2399-second agent budget while the workflow had consumed 1.315M child tokens and 651 tool calls and was killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out after roughly the same budget, with no subagent tokens and 77 Bash calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent substantial budget on a broad child workflow; serial spent its budget entirely on local probing. Both closed without a passing build.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail: both completed evaluator records show compile_failed and 233 tests not run. Parallel differs procedurally because it produced a partial Go source tree while a broad child workflow consumed budget and died without an aggregate result; serial differs because it never left direct probing and submitted no implementation. These differences explain process coverage, not a discordant pass/fail result.
parallel_contributors: Partial late Go implementation was present in the artifact but lacked compile/test closure.
Broad workflow fan-out ended killed with null aggregate result and limited usable spec output.
serial_contributors: Serial stayed in single-agent behavioral probing and did not create implementation source files.
Serial also timed out and failed compile with all tests not run.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel wrote a partial Go codebase; serial wrote no replacement implementation.
Neither run produced a verified buildable executable for the official evaluator.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is adverse parallel process behavior only

Parallel launched an 11-dimension exhaustive workflow and repeatedly retried stalled children; the workflow consumed substantial child tokens/tool calls and ended killed with no aggregate result while parent implementation and compile-test closure remained unfinished.
candidates.realized_consequence: The delegated probe fan-out returned no aggregate result and only two usable spec files by the final check, leaving the late partial Go implementation without compile/test closure before official evaluation.
candidates.near_match_reason: The implementation path was starved, but the directly evidenced cause was broad workflow fan-out plus stall retries exhausting budget; that is more specific than generic starvation.
